# Dentist Sample Pages

Fictional dentist demos can show sample legal pages to demonstrate what a complete customer site may include. These pages are not the real operator's legal pages.

## Required framing

The page intro should say:

- the page is part of a public demo/showcase
- practice name, people, address, phone numbers, services, images, and content are fictional
- no dental services are offered through the demo
- the sample legal page is not the provider identification or privacy policy of the demo operator
- real customer legal text would need individual completion and legal review

When using real jurisdiction-specific references for a fictional story, explain the assumption. For example: Berlin is the assumed location of the fictional sample practice, so Berlin authority/chamber/professional-law references are shown as realistic example data.

## Dentist-specific sample rules

- Treat §5 DDG as the federal baseline, not as the whole dentist-specific checklist.
- Combine DDG with state/chamber guidance for the assumed or real Bundesland/Kammerbezirk.
- Keep chamber and KZV separate. The professional chamber is not the KZV.
- List professional rules and state how they are accessible.
- Use state/chamber-district/practice-form-specific data for real customers; do not hardcode Berlin outside the Berlin demo.
- Include §18 Abs. 2 MStV responsibility only when the site has journalistic-editorial content such as articles or a blog.
- Use safe fictional data: `.example` domains and official demo/media phone number ranges where possible.
